# Backspace Fork 1.15.9

## Changes

- **No desktop compatibility lockout:** removes the mandatory version screen,
  policy polling and minimum-version refusals from API, resumable uploads and
  WebSockets. Old or unavailable version bridges cannot prevent the app opening.
  Optional desktop updates and authentication remain available.
- **Server-only operational diagnostics:** runtime/API/connection failures and
  safe desktop updater/recovery status go to the instance serving the app, never
  a maintainer or third-party collector. No local log files or persistent client
  queue are created. Reports exclude credentials, message/media content, raw
  exception text, user ids, full URLs and local paths.
- **Bounded retention:** central JSONL records rotate within 4.5 GB; Compose
  rotates Backspace, LiveKit and Caddy output within a combined application-log
  budget below 5 GB. The admin diagnostics endpoint reports storage availability
  and drop/failure counters. Offline crashes can lose in-memory reports.
- **No pin queries for voice channels:** removes unnecessary text-pin requests
  that generated repeated 404s while viewing voice channels.

## Operations

- No database migration. Preserve the existing database, uploads and instance
  identity. The retired `BACKSPACE_MIN_DESKTOP_VERSION` variable is ignored.
- Recreate active containers with the updated Compose configuration during a
  maintenance window for Docker rotation limits to apply; voice calls can be
  interrupted. Other deployments need equivalent stdout/stderr rotation.
- Diagnostic retention does not delete uploads, database snapshots, unrelated
  host-service logs or operator-made copies. See `docs/systems/diagnostics.md`.
